tables.title: Cross-model rank agreement and robustness summary
tables.scientific_purpose: Compactly report cross-model concordance and the five distinct robustness comparisons while keeping agreement and displacement conceptually separate.
tables.interpretation_boundary: Agreement and displacement quantify different descriptive properties; neither establishes accuracy or anomaly truth.

tables.title: Representative scientific evidence cases
tables.scientific_purpose: Report frozen ranks and publication-safe roles for four representative objects.
tables.interpretation_boundary: No binary anomaly label or unsupported astrophysical classification; selected candidates are inspection cases, not confirmed anomalies.
